name: golden-hour-red-corset-editorial
image_purpose: fashion lookbook grid and editorial contact sheet

prompt.project_info: Create a 2x2 golden-hour analog fashion editorial grid with one consistent adult woman, red corset styling, and a beige stone wall.
prompt.main_subject: One adult woman using the required approved-adult face reference, preserving the same identity, face, hairstyle, wardrobe, and natural proportions in all panels. She wears a red corset or textured bustier top with black high-waist pants or skirt, dark straight hair with natural strands across the face, and warm natural glam makeup with soft red or nude lips.
prompt.composition_elements: 2x2 grid with thin gutters and no outer border: extreme close-up with hair over one eye; full-body or three-quarter pose with arms raised and strong wall shadow; side-profile close portrait leaning on forearms; tight close-up resting face near forearm with direct eye contact. Beige stone wall with visible seams and outdoor terrace feel.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Hard low-angle golden-hour sunlight with minimal natural bounce, sharp shadow shapes, warm gold and deep-red palette, 35mm film-scan look with subtle halation, dust, vignette, and true analog grain.
prompt.technical_specs: 4:5 portrait grid, 50mm lens look, crisp eyes in close-ups, gentle falloff, natural skin texture, analog editorial realism, no text, logos, or watermark.
